facts.fact: The Standard reports that the Nafa cash transfer, run by the National Nutrition Agency with the Department of Community Development and the Directorate of Social Welfare under the World Bank-funded RISE Project, was paid electronically through QMoney's platform, provincial beneficiaries receiving their fifth round and Banjul, KMC and parts of Kombo their first.

systems.country_label: GMD 3,000 monthly paid via QMoney, nationwide rollout complete
